rent.method: Mean of the most recent 3-bedroom averages from five rental-listing trackers.
rent.trend_note: 3-bed rents are roughly flat year over year (RentHop +0.7%, Zumper +3%); apartment-only rents dipped about 3% (Apartments.com).

price.basis: Median sold price, all Brandon homes, trailing 12 months. Brandon's median home is a 3-bed of about 1,700 sq ft, so this is a reasonable proxy for a typical 3/2.
price.trend_note: Prices are flat to slightly up (Momentum +1.8% YoY; ZIP 33511 −3.9%). Homes go under contract in about 36 days, with about 3.7 months of supply.

notes.text: Property tax: Hillsborough County's 2025 total millage is about 15.73 mills, applied after a ~$50k homestead exemption.
Insurance: average Citizens premium for Hillsborough County, 2026 approved rate ($2,425/yr).
The 4.5% rate is your fixed what-if rate, not today's market rate. PMI is assumed at 0.5%/yr when the down payment is under 20%.
